description: This PHP source file contains a unit test class named 'ValidationDecoratorTest' which tests the functionality of the 'ValidationDecorator' class in the context of API parameter validation within the OrangeHRM system. The test class includes data providers and test methods to verify validation logic and exception handling for API request parameters.
